scope: Fixed first-nine-layer future-to-current cut transferred without tuning to X+15/18cm, two frozen V realizations with A195. Every native is a fresh new-scene reference; every sham/cut uses that same scene/V reference. Four cut cases and four numerical sham classification controls are preregistered for physics, without q0 selection. Only along-X transfer is tested. Hard masks also reallocate attention. No new physics, training, semantic anatomy or general root-cause claim.
